relationship: Final HR-stage interaction detail for the owner-approved loops-single-spine-dossier-v4.png

interactionContract.stage: Only guide/material, interview question cards, and stage result/status are ordinary stage content.
interactionContract.compact: Each question card keeps its title, explicit owner assessment, and expand affordance visible.
interactionContract.expanded: Question context, My approach, and My review remain together inside the selected card; no verbatim-answer reconstruction.
interactionContract.siblings: Only the selected question expands; siblings remain compact and move in normal flow.
interactionContract.excluded: No separate round self-assessment or interviewer-feedback cards are rendered or solicited.
interactionContract.truth: All populated values are illustrative and must not be treated as saved interview history.
